args.notes: System spec: bursty Poisson arrivals (bursts of 8, 2 req/us avg), p99 latency <= 0.4us is only screened by an analytic bound at L1, so favour designs with real throughput/latency headroom (pipelined / higher n_iter throughput) that survive L2. Select rule is min luts_plus_ffs, so keep small-area designs alive, plus points spanning accuracy for a well-mapped front.
